identification: Low rolled-rim bulb/flower bowl, blue and yellow/orange drip glaze, incised base 'J (H?) McHugh Tasmania', date 1935 (or 1955) and number 55. Genuine McHugh (Launceston) pottery. Hairline crack through rim and chip at foot, as catalogued. Common domestic-size piece, not one of the rare trough/figural forms.
